title: paspalum barbatum
intro: Paspalum barbatum, commonly known as Bhatasala or Bhatasala grass, is a type of tropical grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Paspalum barbatum include its ability to reduce inflammation and relieve pain, as well as its antibacterial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
